projectDescription: A proof-of-performance capital protocol on Solana where traders earn capital by proving skill through a verified on-chain Arcadia Score, and investors allocate through non-custodial smart-contract vaults.
keyFeatures: Arcadia Score (0–1000) — verifiable on-chain reputation derived from trading history
Five performance tiers: Verified, Established, Advanced, Elite, Apex — each unlocking higher capital capacity and profit share
Non-custodial smart-contract vaults — investor capital is held on-chain, never in the trader's wallet
Proof-of-performance capital allocation — capacity unlocked by score, not collateral
Trading terminal with live market data for perp positions (FlashTrade / Drift / Phoenix)
Investor portfolio dashboard with real-time NAV, PnL, and vault activity tracking
Leaderboard of top traders by Arcadia Score and 30-day return
Sign-In With Solana (SIWS) — wallet-native authentication, no passwords
Performance fee sharing: traders earn 20–40% of profits above high-water mark
Trader classification: automated bot/human detection and trading style labeling
publicApiSurface: GET /v1/traders — paginated trader list with scores, tiers, and capacity
GET /v1/traders/:handle — full trader profile with equity curve and trades
GET /v1/traders/:handle/score-history — historical Arcadia Score snapshots
GET /v1/traders/:handle/pnl-history — per-day realized PnL
GET /v1/traders/:handle/classification — bot/human verdict and style label
GET /v1/vaults/:profile — vault state: NAV/share, AUM, shares, HWM, status
GET /v1/vaults/:profile/trades — paginated trade history
GET /v1/vaults/:profile/nav-history — daily NAV + AUM history
GET /v1/leaderboard — top 100 by score and top 100 by 30-day return
GET /v1/prices — current Pyth price cache
GET /v1/score?wallet= — machine-readable score for a wallet (API key auth)
POST /v1/auth/challenge — issue SIWS nonce
POST /v1/auth/verify — verify SIWS signature and return JWT
POST /v1/auth/privy — verify Privy token and return JWT
GET /v1/investors/:wallet/account — investor positions and stats
GET /v1/investors/:wallet/portfolio — portfolio with current value and PnL
GET /v1/investors/:wallet/flows — deposit/withdrawal history
GET /v1/me — current user role and wallet
POST /v1/waitlist — waitlist signup
findTraderProfile(trader: PublicKey) — derive trader profile PDA
findInvestorAccount(wallet: PublicKey) — derive investor account PDA
fetchTraderProfile(connection, trader) — read on-chain trader profile
fetchInvestorAccount(connection, wallet) — read on-chain investor account
fetchInvestorPosition(connection, owner, profile) — read on-chain position
